vehicles.name: SM_Moto_SH
vehicles.units: metres, Unity axes (x right, y up, z forward); origin = ground, wheelbase midpoint
vehicles.material: M_HanoiMoto: atlas Blender/moto/T_MotoAtlas.png + T_MotoAtlasData.png; paint tint where UV is in the PAINT cell (u < 0.125, v > 0.875); alpha clip 0.5 (atlas alpha: see-through between the wheel spokes)

rig.hierarchy: FBX is flat: SM_Moto_SH_Rig > Body_LODn, Steer_LODn, WheelF_LODn, WheelR_LODn (origins on their pivots), anchors. In Unity: Steer pivot holds Steer_LODn + WheelF pivot (WheelF_LODn); rotate Steer about steer_axis, wheels about local X.
